responsibility: Defines backend interfaces for creating and attaching debug information, including crate/function debug contexts, scopes, locations, variables, vtable debug metadata, and builder operations that place source locations and variable address records into generated IR.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `mir/debuginfo.rs`, which manages per-function MIR debug state and computes what should be described, this file defines the backend contracts for creating scopes, locations, variables, and attaching variable/location records to generated IR.
